{{Top|leg}}
The '''Pakkerd Light Transport plant''' was a factory located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ession]]. It produced a variety of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles for use by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>

During the [[Hunt for Zsinj|campaign]] against [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]], the plant was used as bait for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces supposedly shadowing the Zsinj-aligned ship [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller'']]. What Zsinj didn't know was that the ship was under the control of [[Wraith Squadron]], a New Republic [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]]. They passed the information to the New Republic military and a team of commandos prevented the plant's [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] from launching and joining the [[Battle of Ession|battle]].<ref name="WS" />
